take_homes: You can't judge an agent by reading its answers. You run a written check and sign off the leftover risk on record.
The cheapest fix is giving the agent less access. My own memo agent could send to the CEO unreviewed until the audit caught it.
Hidden text in a document can steer an agent, so outside files count as untrusted.

monday.move: Ask IT who approved which tool for finance data, and whether any agent we pilot can send or write anything outside the department
monday.who: IT lead, with my controller copied
monday.stop_condition: No named approval by Friday means no finance data goes into any agent tool
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data

misconception.why: The training says good outcomes come from the organisation running the check, not from the best tool, and the audit I ran was built in-house. But nothing in the module priced it, so I still can't say what it costs per month for 40 people.

one_line: Useful on risk acceptance and the audit found real problems, but forty minutes of setup and nobody said what it costs.
